gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The risk-gated gas floor changed 92 and 104 actions on the two registered consumed TRAIN cells. Mean gas rose from 0.063/0.063 to 0.092/0.099, with 2/2 completion in both arms and zero invalid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
